current_types_and_result_codes.sql_redacted_template: SELECT 'PARENT_TYPE' AS LAYER, ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE AS CODE, COUNT(*) AS N FROM ODS.V_INF_EX_LAB WHERE ID IN (:key_1,:key_2,:key_3) GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE UNION ALL SELECT 'ITEM_CODE', NVL(EXAMINATION_RESULT_CODE,'(NULL)'), COUNT(*) FROM ODS.V_INF_EX_LAB_ITEM WHERE EX_LAB_ID IN (:key_1,:key_2,:key_3) GROUP BY EXAMINATION_RESULT_CODE

v13_join_multiplication.sql_redacted_template: SELECT CASE p.ID WHEN :key_1 THEN 'P1' WHEN :key_2 THEN 'P2' WHEN :key_3 THEN 'P3' END AS REPORT_LABEL, COUNT(*) AS V13_REJOIN_ROWS, MAX(b.CAND_CNT) AS DECLARED_CANDIDATES FROM ODS.V_INF_EX_LAB p JOIN ODS.M_INF_FXHIS_ACTIVITY_V13 b ON b.SERIAL_NUMBER=p.SERIAL_NUMBER WHERE p.ID IN (:key_1,:key_2,:key_3) GROUP BY p.ID

operator_department_fallback.sql_redacted_template: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TARGET_REPORTS, SUM(CASE WHEN a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NO_TRANSCRIPTIONIST, SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=TO_CHAR(a.PERFORMED_BY)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DEPT_HITS, SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT s WHERE s.EMP_NO=TO_CHAR(a.PERFORMED_BY)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STAFF_HITS FROM HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER a WHERE a.TEST_NO IN (:key_4,:key_5,:key_6,:key_7,:key_8,:key_9)
